intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies and no difficulty setting. Play the story first and let the trophies come to you, then clean up in free roam after the credits. The only thing you can miss is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1.
rules: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Never use cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth.
The 100% checklist only appears after the story, but everything you do before then already counts.

stages.blurb: Play the story and enjoy it. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the moment it appears, and start scanning WAiNK spots and discovering vehicles as you travel.
stages.title: Chapters 1–2 — learn Leonida

stages.blurb: Finish the story. Bank jobs open after Credit Check in Chapter 3; jewelry stores after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Save before the final mission.
stages.title: Chapters 3–4 and the finale

stages.blurb: Clear the six side-character finales and 8 stranger strands. None of these can be missed — they all stay open after the story.
stages.title: Side characters and strangers

stages.blurb: Cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, animals and the whole map. These are the long, calm grinds — do them with music on.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.blurb: Stunts, shooting ranges, races, drone races, fishing, bowling, the gym and the property grind. Start the shooting range early — it is the longest single grind.
stages.title: Activities and money

stages.blurb: Partner crimes, vaults, gang operations and the 500 Criminal Profile actions, then the 100% checklist and the platinum itself.
stages.title: Robberies and the long tail

title: Road to the Platinum
